snippet.title: BEFORE I GO | Demo Update 1.0.4
snippet.description:
Demo Update 1.0.4, released in March 2025

BEFORE I GO is a punishing metroidvania with intense platforming and unforgiving battle action. Explore an otherworldly universe. Immerse yourself in this enigmatic tale. Face your greatest fear.

Check out the Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715870/Before_I_Go/
